sloka: इह मे स्थण्डिले शीघ्रं कुशानास्तर सारथे ।आर्य्यं प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि यावन्मे न प्रसीदति ॥ २.१११.१३॥
transliteration: iha me sthaṇḍile śīghraṁ kuśānāstara sārathe ।āryyaṁ pratyupavekṣyāmi yāvanme na prasīdati ॥ 2.111.13॥

translations.english: O charioteer, quickly spread kusa grass on the bare ground. Until my esteemed brother shows his grace, I shall lie down here -- waiting.
